title: Source-assisted complex word on PR168 v4 modules: conditional κ = 6.626307e-4
body:
## Result

Conditional κ = 6626307/10^10 = **0.0006626307**, about 0.1126% above PR186 (0.000661885549259598).

The complex supplier binds. Its saving is b = 3315351/(5·10^9) = 0.0006630702. PR184's effective bit saving, about 0.00066522948, is larger.

## What changed

PR184 (icekylinx) built a source-parity local word (all G channels `s`, all A channels `fd`, F = 2) and a source-assisted frame flow on the old PR168 snapshot `fd25adb7fbaa12ee761d02c733c54d1d2a7687ee`. Its complex saving was 6.570752e-4.

This PR runs PR184's construction on PR168 v4's query modules and physical layer instead. The newer modules raise the complex saving by 0.91%, to 6.630702e-4.

| Quantity | PR184 (fd25adb7 modules) | This PR (v4 modules) |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Physical auxiliaries R | 11,056 | 10,824 |
| Persistent roles W | 13,696 | 13,464 |
| Source-controlled erasures | 1,410 | 1,412 |
| Zero-fresh kernel reuses | 706 | 707 |
| Complex saving | 6.570752e-4 | 6.630702e-4 |
| κ | 6.566436e-4 | 6.626307e-4 |

Two files derive from PR184 code. `source_aligned_local_v4.py` changes only the three module file names. `contract_v4.py` pins this package's frozen pairs instead of PR184's, and every check is unchanged. PR184's `complex_frame_flow.py`, `exact_complex_flow_lift.py`, `assemble_profiles.py`, `FINITE_BRIDGE.txt` and bit supplier run unchanged from their own directory.

## Verify

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/source-assisted/requirements-round13.txt
python3 -B research/source-assisted-v4/verify.py
```

It takes about one minute. It regenerates the v4 cache and the new local word, with the physical checks of `paired_cube_physical.physical()`. It then runs the flow, the exact lift, the contract checks and the 47-constraint assembly, and compares the result with `certificate.json`. The workflow `.github/workflows/source-assisted-v4.yml` runs it in CI.

## Branch

The branch stacks on PR185's head `32daefe471e1e41926971747bb901e2839938b43`, with PR184's commit merged. The second commit only updates shared-file hashes that the merge made stale: the joint-dual certificates and the PR182 and PR185 manifests. The PR182 and PR185 verifiers pass on this branch.

## Scope

PR184's validation scope applies. The exact lift and the contract checks establish the local maps and the flow ledger. There is no globally renumbered scalar transcript of the new complex word and no full Clifford/router replay. The bit supplier and its scope are PR184's. The analytic, recursion, precision, weighted frame, fixed-tape routing, restored-row and all-size interfaces stay as assumptions.
